packageRules.description: pnpm 11 rejects installing any lockfile entry published within the last 24h as a supply-chain guard. Keep Renovate's npm bumps a step behind that cutoff so a same-day merge doesn't leave `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` failing for a day.
Auto-merge minor/patch/pin/digest updates once the required guard and ci checks pass. Major bumps still land as an open PR for a manual look.
